verdict.rationale: Fern Agent automations can review a docs owner's reader feedback, unanswered Ask Fern questions, search queries, and analytics, then report findings and open pull requests. That is AI-generated insight and suggestion drawn from the user's own data inside the product. The evidence is a single changelog entry, though, and it frames this as a scheduled, prompt-driven agent task rather than a built-in insights surface. Ask Fern serves end-user Q&A, not owner insights. missing for 10: a dedicated in-product insights/suggestions view, detailed first-party docs on how findings are presented, insight coverage beyond the listed data sources, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Automations can review your reader feedback, unanswered Ask Fern questions, search queries, or analytics, report back what it found, and open a pull request when the prompt asks for a change.
Fern Agent reads your docs site’s source repository and makes the changes you describe.
